name: secondhand-items
description: Secondhand marketplace - buy and sell used items

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
